note: Two distinct legal entities share the name. (1) ADVANCE RUB CORK INTERNATIONAL, Bhiwadi/Alwar, Rajasthan — the operating manufacturer/trader of rubberised cork sheet; has genuine outbound customs records to Egypt (2024-12-02, HS 40082190, BOL 6091055) and Uganda (2024-08-20, HS 45041010, BOL 3329950), plus inbound cork granules from Metacork Technology Nanjing (2026-02-02, HS 45019000, BOL 7258310) and a plastic crusher from Zhangjiagang Kwell (2024-04-04, BOL 2883851) — i.e. it imports raw cork and machinery and exports finished sheet, consistent with a converter. (2) ADVANCE CORK INTERNATIONAL, Karol Bagh, New Delhi — only 2 records, both exhibition re-imports/booth cargo to and from Germany, no commercial sale evidenced. Declared HS 450490 (agglomerated cork, other) does not match the observed codes: exports were 40082190 (rubber-cork sheet) and 45041010 (blocks/plates/sheets of agglomerated cork), imports 45019000 and 45020000. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: keep the company, correct the HS to the observed 45041010 / 40082190, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer_trader (imports raw cork, converts, exports). Owner name KARAN SACHDEV could not be verified — no registry or filing source was reachable, so it stays unconfirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (ImportKey free view gives record counts, not values). Domestic supply side is genuinely unverified, not negative — the search tool was down for this entire run, so 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'.
